original: スタンさんもルーティさんも\nその歳できちんとした夢があって\nすごいというか……立派ですよね
traducao: Both you and Rutee have clear dreams\nat your age... It's really admirable,\nStahn.

original: 立派？
traducao: Admirable?

original: ああ、ルーティはそうだよな
traducao: Ah, Rutee definitely is.

original: 孤児院を建てるのは、ずっと昔からの\n夢というか、目標だったみたいなんだ
traducao: Building an orphanage has been her dream\nand goal since way back, it seems.

original: 俺はその手伝いをしてるけど\n自分の夢とか、将来とか\nそういうのはまだよくわかんないよ
traducao: I'm just helping her out with it.\nAs for my own dreams and future,\nI still don't really know.

original: またまたそんな、ご謙遜を
traducao: Come now, don't be so modest!

original: スタンさんはルーティさんと一緒に\nその孤児院を建てるつもりなんでしょう？
traducao: You plan to build that orphanage\ntogether with Rutee, right, Stahn?

original: なら、スタンさんも十分立派ですよ
traducao: Then that makes you admirable too, Stahn!

original: いやいや、そんな事ないって
traducao: No, no, it's not like that at all.

original: ほんとに「家で昼寝してる暇があるなら\nちょっと手伝いなさいよ！」って\nルーティに駆りだされただけなんだから
traducao: She told me, "If you have time to nap,\ncome help out!" and dragged me along.\nThat's really all it is.

original: 妹にも、寝てばっかりいるより\n他人様の役に立つ事をした方が\nずっといいとか言われるし
traducao: My sister always tells me that doing\ngood for others is way better than\njust sleeping all day, too.

original: えーと……\n念の為にお伺いしますが
traducao: Er... Just to be completely sure,\nmay I ask you something?

original: 本当にそれだけ……なんですか？
traducao: Is that seriously... all there is to it?

original: その……スタンさんがルーティさんと\n一緒にいる理由、っていうのは……
traducao: I mean... your reason for being\ntogether with Rutee, Stahn...?

original: ああ、そうだよ
traducao: Yeah, pretty much.

original: （おいおいおい……！！\n　この二人、本気で全っ然何にも\n　進展してないのかよ？）
traducao: (Hold on, hold on, hold on...!!\nHave those two seriously made\nzero romantic progress!?)

original: （カイルはちゃんと\n　生まれてくるんだろうな！？）
traducao: (Is Kyle even going to be\nborn properly at this rate!?)

original: （っていうか、俺達の未来は\n　大丈夫なのか〜〜ッ！？）
traducao: (Wait, is our entire future\ngonna be all right~~~!?)

original: ロニ？\n大丈夫か？　\nおーい
traducao: Loni?\nAre you all right?\nHeeey!

original: グー、グー、……
traducao: Zzz, zzz...

original: ス、スタンさん……
traducao: S-Stahn...

original: スタンさん、\nこんな所で寝ていたら、\n風邪引きますよ
traducao: Stahn,\nif you sleep in a place like this,\nyou'll catch a cold.

original: ぐおー、ぐおー、……
traducao: Snore, snore...

original: 起きそうにないですね……
traducao: He doesn't look like he'll wake up...

original: （毛布を掛けておけば、\n　風邪は引かないでしょうから……）
traducao: (If I put a blanket over him,\nhe won't catch cold, so...)

original: （スタンさんって、\n　寝ている時、\n　本当に気持ち良さそう……）
traducao: (Stahn really looks\nso peaceful and content\nwhen he sleeps...)

original: （私も、隣りで……）
traducao: (Maybe I could... beside him...)

original: んごー！
traducao: *snort*!

original: （わ、私、一体……）
traducao: (W-What on earth am I thinking...?)

original: （こうして、\n　そばで寝顔を\n　見られるだけで……）
traducao: (Just being here,\nable to look at his sleeping face\nis more than enough...)

original: ふごーーー！！！
traducao: *SNORRRTE*!!!

original: ついに来るとこまで来ちまったな……
traducao: We've finally hit rock bottom...

original: 所持金０ガルド、かぁ……
traducao: Zero Gald to our names, huh...?

original: そう気を落とすなって。\nここからまた始めるって\n思えばいいじゃないか
traducao: Don't look so down!\nWe can just think of this as\na fresh starting point!

original: スタンはほんとに前向きだなぁ
traducao: You're always so positive, Stahn.

original: でも、スタンの言う通りだよ
traducao: Still, Stahn is right.

original: ここを出発点と考えて、またみんなで少しずつ\nガルドを貯めていけばいいさ。\nこれまで、そうして来たみたいに、ね
traducao: Let's treat this as our new starting\npoint and save up Gald together bit\nby bit, just as we've done so far.

original: クレス……
traducao: Cress...

original: ……そうだな。\n金は天下の回り物って言うしな
traducao: ...Guess so.\nMoney comes and goes, as they say.

original: 落ち込んでても仕方ねーか
traducao: No point moping around about it.

original: 出来る事があったら協力するから\n何でも言ってくれよな、\n○○
traducao: If there's anything I can do to help,\njust say the word,\n○○!

original: こういう時こそ、みんなで力を合わせよう！
traducao: Times like this are when we unite!

original: 逃走回数１０回かぁ……
traducao: Ten escapes, huh...?

original: 何だよカイウス。\n珍しく落ち込んでるじゃねえか
traducao: What's up, Caius?\nRare to see you looking so down.

original: 珍しくって何だよ！\nオレだって真剣に考え事くらいするさ
traducao: What do you mean, "rare"!?\nEven I can think seriously sometimes!

original: カイウスは何を悩んでるんだ？
traducao: What are you troubled about, Caius?

original: 悩んでるっていうか……
traducao: Well, less troubled, more like...

original: 最近、ちょっと敵から\n逃げ過ぎじゃないかなって……
traducao: I was wondering if we haven't been\nrunning from enemies a bit too much...

original: そうかぁ？\n逃げるのも、立派な戦略の一つだぜ
traducao: You think so?\nRunning away is a valid strategy, too.

original: オレは別に気にしないけどな
traducao: Doesn't bother me in the slightest.

original: わかってるよ。\nだけど……やっぱりオレは悔しいんだ
traducao: I know that.\nStill... it just frustrates me.

original: ○○には\nきっと何か考えがあるんだろ
traducao: ○○ surely has\na plan in mind.

original: 怪我人が増えてるとか、お金がないとか\nそういうわけでもないんだし。\nもっと、気楽に考えていいんじゃないか？
traducao: It's not like our injured are piling up\nor we're out of money, right?\nYou can take it a bit easier!

original: 出た。\nスタンの前向き思考！
traducao: There it is.\nStahn's classic positive thinking!

original: スタンに言われると、本当に\nそういうものかもって気がしてくるから\n不思議なんだよなぁ……
traducao: When Stahn says it,\nit really starts to feel that way.\nIt's pretty mysterious...

original: わぁ〜、でっかい森だなぁ！\nほら、窓の外全部が緑だぞ！
traducao: Whoa, that is a huge forest!\nLook, the entire window is green!

original: うわぁ、ほんとだ！
traducao: Whoa, you're right!

original: いいなぁ、わたしも外に出たかったな。\n陽射しがとっても気持ち良さそう
traducao: Nice! I wish I could go outside too.\nThe sunlight looks so wonderful.

original: ああ。\nそれに、昼寝にちょうど良さそう……
traducao: Yeah.\nAnd it looks perfect for a nap...

original: ふあ……
traducao: *yawn*...

original: ああ、そういえば今日\n全然昼寝してないんだよなぁ……
traducao: Come to think of it, I haven't had\na nap at all today...

original: 丁度いいや。\nこの景色見ながら昼寝するよ、俺
traducao: This is perfect.\nI'll take a nap while watching the view.

original: ちょ、ちょっとスタン？\nダメだよ、こんなとこで寝たら……
traducao: H-Hold on, Stahn!?\nYou can't sleep here...

original: ……って、もう寝ちゃった
traducao: ...Wait, he's already asleep!

original: もう……スタン！\nスタンってばぁ！
traducao: Geez... Stahn!\nStahn, wake up!

original: 俺達に出来る事から\n少しずつ頑張っていこうな、カイル！
traducao: Let's do our best with what we can,\none step at a time, Kyle!

original: うん！　父さ……
traducao: Yeah! D-Dad...

original: ……じゃなかった
traducao: ...I mean...

original: スタンさん！！
traducao: Mr. Stahn!!

original: 随分盛り上がってるなぁ
traducao: They're getting pretty into it.

original: 気が合うんだろ。\n何となく、見た目も似てるしな
traducao: They must hit it off.\nThey kinda look alike too, after all.

original: そういやそうだな。\n性格が熱いとこなんかもソックリだぜ
traducao: Now that you mention it, yeah.\nTheir fiery tempers are identical.

original: いいねえ、若いってのは。\nオレはそういうのはパスだ
traducao: Must be nice being young.\nI'll pass on that whole deal.

original: だよなぁ。\nオレも基本的には、昼寝が出来て\n食い物さえありゃ、何でもいいや
traducao: Right?\nBasically, as long as I get food and\na nap, I'm happy with anything.

original: おっ。\nそりゃ、言えてるな
traducao: Heh.\nYou can say that again.

original: だろ？
traducao: Told ya.

original: 何だかあの二人、\n盛り上がってるなぁ
traducao: Those two over there sure look\nlike they're hitting it off!

original: うん。\nユーリとリッドってちょっと性格も似てるし…。\n気が合うのかもしれないね
traducao: Yeah.\nYuri and Reid are a bit alike, so...\nmaybe they just click.

original: いいなあ。\n何か、青春って感じで。\n仲間って言うのはああじゃなくちゃ
traducao: How nice!\nFeels like real youth, you know?\nThat's how comrades should be!

original: うん。\nそうだね！
traducao: Yeah.\nYou're right!
Hmph......

original: うわぁ〜、\n何か、すっごい重い空気〜
traducao: Whoa...\nThe mood over there is so heavy~

original: しかも、あの顔ぶれよ。\n重要な話をしているのかもね……
traducao: And look at that lineup.\nThey must be discussing something big...

original: 一人だけを除いては……
traducao: Except for one person, that is...

original: ほら、見て……
traducao: Look, see...?

original: はぅわ！\nあれって、もしかして……？
traducao: Gasp!\nWait, don't tell me that's...!?

original: 一人だけ、寝てるのよ……。\n全く、お兄ちゃんたら……
traducao: He's the only one asleep...\nGood grief, big brother...

original: むにゃ…………
traducao: Mumble......

original: うわ、エミル！？
traducao: Whoa, Emil!?

original: どうしたんだよ、\n目が真っ赤じゃないか
traducao: What happened to you?\nYour eyes are bright red!

original: 悪かったな。\nこれは生まれつきだ
traducao: Too bad for you.\nI was born this way.

original: 生まれつきじゃないだろ？\nエミルの目は綺麗な緑だったはずだ
traducao: You weren't born like that, right?\nYour eyes are a pretty green, Emil.

original: はっ……だったらどうだってんだよ
traducao: Hah... So what if they are?

original: 医者に診せよう！
traducao: Let's have a doctor look at you!

original: アニーならきっと何とかしてくれるよ
traducao: I'm sure Annie can do something!

original: 医者だと！？\nおい、ふざけ……
traducao: A doctor!?\nHey, quit messing around...

original: 大丈夫、目なら多分\n注射はされないはずだから！\n行こう！！
traducao: Don't worry, if it's your eyes,\nthey probably won't give you a shot!\nLet's go!!

original: 別に、注射が嫌なわけじゃねえ〜！！
traducao: It's not that I hate getting shots~~!!

traducao: Normal.\n
